label_definition.1: PASS - Viable substitution that preserves chemical function, fermentation microbes, or structural integrity
label_definition.0: FAIL - Non-viable substitution that causes structural collapse, microbial death/toxicity, or recipe ruin

labels.proposed_substitution: All-Purpose Flour (10% protein) 1:1 with 5% hydration reduction
labels.human_rationale: Slightly lower protein flour compensated by 5% hydration reduction maintains gluten structure and dough workability.

labels.proposed_substitution: 100% Coconut Flour 1:1 without additional binders or water adjustment
labels.human_rationale: Coconut flour lacks gluten and absorbs 4x more water; 1:1 direct swap yields unworkable dry crumbling sawdust.

labels.proposed_substitution: 3x Batch Multiplication (3000g Flour, 2250g Water, 600g Starter, 60g Salt)
labels.human_rationale: Baker's percentages (100% flour, 75% water, 20% starter, 2% salt) are perfectly preserved for 3 standard loaves.

labels.proposed_substitution: Yondu Umami Vegetable Broth + Dried Kelp (Dashima) Soaking Water
labels.human_rationale: Provides rich glutamate-based umami replacing fish sauce without disturbing lactic acid fermentation.

labels.proposed_substitution: Iodized Table Salt with Sodium Ferrocyanide Anti-Caking Agent 1:1 by weight
labels.human_rationale: Iodine and chemical anti-caking agents inhibit lactic acid bacteria, causing limp soggy texture and metallic off-flavors.

labels.proposed_substitution: 1 US Gallon Scaling (3785g Water, 270g Cane Sugar, 27g Black Tea, 378g Starter Liquid)
labels.human_rationale: Exact volumetric scaling preserving 7.14% sucrose, 0.71% tea leaves, and 10% starter acidity for 1 US gallon.

labels.proposed_substitution: Raw Unpasteurized Antibacterial Honey 1:1 by weight
labels.human_rationale: Raw unpasteurized honey possesses antimicrobial enzymes and hydrogen peroxide that suppress primary SCOBY cultures.

labels.proposed_substitution: Barley Koji (Mugi Koji) cultivated with Aspergillus oryzae 1:1 by weight
labels.human_rationale: Barley koji is an established traditional miso variant (Mugi Miso) with identical proteolytic enzyme activity.

labels.proposed_substitution: Low-Sodium Modification reducing salt to 20g (4.0% ratio)
labels.human_rationale: Long-term ambient miso aging requires at least 12% salt; 4% salt causes rapid putrefaction and dangerous mold proliferation.

labels.proposed_substitution: Black Tea Leaves (Assam) in cheesecloth sachet (2g) for natural tannins
labels.human_rationale: Black tea supplies condensed tannins that effectively inhibit pectinase softening enzymes, preserving pickle crunch.

labels.proposed_substitution: Tap Water with Zero Salt to make sodium-free pickles
labels.human_rationale: Salt-free ambient vegetable soaking invites anaerobic pathogens and rotting microorganisms instead of lactic acid bacteria.

labels.proposed_substitution: Fresh Blackberries (500g) with 2.0% Non-Iodized Salt (10g)
labels.human_rationale: Fresh blackberries host native lactobacillus and ferment cleanly at 2.0% salinity in anaerobic conditions.

labels.proposed_substitution: Open Bowl with Cheesecloth Cover at Room Temperature
labels.human_rationale: Exposing salted whole berries to open ambient air promotes Kahm yeast and mold blooms rather than anaerobic lacto-fermentation.

labels.proposed_substitution: European Block Cultured Vegan Butter (80% fat) 1:1 by weight
labels.human_rationale: Solid cold cultured plant butter with 80% fat incorporates into gluten dough creating proper enriched brioche crumb.

labels.proposed_substitution: Liquid Extra Virgin Olive Oil (250g) poured in with water
labels.human_rationale: High proportions of liquid oil destroy the gluten matrix during initial kneading, yielding greasy soupy batter.

labels.proposed_substitution: Diamond Crystal Kosher Salt (20g by weight)
labels.human_rationale: Pure sodium chloride without additives measured by mass provides identical ionic dough tightening.

labels.proposed_substitution: Kosher Salt measured as 1 Tablespoon by volume instead of weight
labels.human_rationale: Volumetric salt density varies drastically (8g to 18g/Tbsp), leading to severe under-salting or yeast suppression.

labels.proposed_substitution: Coarsely Ground Red Aleppo Pepper + Paprika (40g/40g blend)
labels.human_rationale: Replaces gochugaru heat and color safely without altering pH drops or water activity in the vegetable paste.

labels.proposed_substitution: Pure Carolina Reaper Pepper Powder (80g 1:1 by weight)
labels.human_rationale: Carolina reaper is ~1.5M Scoville; 80g is a hazardous concentration that renders the dish dangerously caustic and inedible.

labels.proposed_substitution: Pure Essential Oil of Peppermint (25 drops) in place of tea
labels.human_rationale: Essential oils are concentrated antimicrobials that damage SCOBY cellular membranes and prevent gas exchange.

labels.proposed_substitution: Dried Organic Chickpeas (Garbanzo Beans, 500g) 1:1 by weight
labels.human_rationale: Chickpea miso is a recognized soy-free alternative with similar protein and carbohydrate fermentability.

labels.proposed_substitution: Kosher Salt (35g by weight in 1000g Water = 3.5% Brine)
labels.human_rationale: Additive-free kosher salt by weight creates an identical 3.5% brine supporting selective lactobacillus growth.

labels.proposed_substitution: Canned Blueberry Pie Filling in High-Fructose Corn Syrup (500g)
labels.human_rationale: Cooked canned pie filling has dead microflora, excessive refined syrup, and thickeners incompatible with lacto-fermentation.

labels.proposed_substitution: Commercial Active Dry Yeast (7g) + Water (100g) + Flour (100g) Poolish
labels.human_rationale: Commercial yeast poolish delivers reliable gas leavening and aroma while baking a structured country loaf.

labels.proposed_substitution: Green Tea (Sencha, 25g) for a lighter Jun-style Fermentation
labels.human_rationale: Green tea provides adequate purines and tannins to feed the SCOBY culture for successful Jun-style kombucha.
